# docker.image builds from a Dockerfile at a given path and finds its inputs
# there: COPY sources, with ARG and ENV expanded in their paths. Changing a
# copied file rebuilds, changing any other file doesn't, ref pins the tag to
# the image ID, a rebuild removes the previous image, and --clean removes
# the image's tags this target created, but not another project's.
[!docker] skip

# HOME is empty, so the docker CLI finds no user-installed buildx plugin.
exec sh -c 'p=$(command -v docker-buildx) || exit 0; mkdir -p "$HOME/.docker/cli-plugins" && ln -s "$p" "$HOME/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx"'

bit
stdout 'image ▶ docker buildx build -t bit-test-image-[0-9a-f]{12}:v1 -f \./docker/Dockerfile --load --build-arg ID=[0-9a-f]{12} --build-arg VARIANT=blue \.$'
stdout 'image ✔ ok'
bit names
grep '^ref=bit-test-image-[0-9a-f]{12}:[0-9a-f]{64}$' names.sh
exec sh show.sh /variant.txt
stdout '\Ablue\n\z'
exec sh show.sh /app.txt
stdout '\Aapp\n\z'
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && test "$(docker image inspect --format "{{.Id}}" "$tag")" = "sha256:${ref##*:}"'
cp names.sh first.sh

bit
stdout 'image · no changes'

# Neither the unselected variant nor a file outside the Dockerfile is an input.
cp changed.txt assets/red.txt
cp changed.txt unrelated.txt
bit
stdout 'image · no changes'

# A rebuild removes the previous image's pinned tag, and with it the image.
cp changed.txt app.txt
bit
stdout 'image ▶ docker rmi bit-test-image-[0-9a-f]{12}:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
stdout 'image ✔ ok'
bit names
exec sh show.sh /app.txt
stdout '\Achanged\n\z'
! exec sh -c '. ./first.sh && docker image inspect "$ref"'

cp changed.txt assets/blue.txt
bit
stdout 'image ✔ ok'
bit names
exec sh show.sh /variant.txt
stdout '\Achanged\n\z'

# A build argument selects another file.
cp BUILD.bit.red BUILD.bit
cp red.txt assets/red.txt
bit
stdout 'image ▶ .*--build-arg VARIANT=red'
stdout 'image ✔ ok'
bit names
exec sh show.sh /variant.txt
stdout '\Ared\n\z'
cp names.sh saved.sh

# Another project's tag for the same image, used by its container, is left.
exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker tag "$ref" "${tag%:*}-other:v1" && docker create --name "${tag%:*}-other" "${tag%:*}-other:v1" none >/dev/null'
bit --clean
stdout 'image ▶ docker rmi -f bit-test-image-[0-9a-f]{12}:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker image inspect "$ref"'
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker image inspect "$tag"'
exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker image inspect "${tag%:*}-other:v1" >/dev/null'
exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker rm "${tag%:*}-other" >/dev/null && docker rmi "${tag%:*}-other:v1" >/dev/null'

# The build cache loads the removed image back under both tags.
bit
stdout 'image ⇣ .*\(cached\)$'
stdout 'image │ docker image load'
! stdout '#[0-9]+ '
exec sh show.sh /variant.txt
stdout '\Ared\n\z'
exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker image inspect "$tag"'
bit --clean
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker image inspect "$ref"'
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && repo=${tag%:*} && docker images -q --filter "label=id=${repo##*-}" | grep .'

-- BUILD.bit --
let id = replace(sha256(project_dir()), "^(.{12}).*$", "$1")

image = docker.image {
  tag        = "bit-test-image-#{id}:v1"
  dockerfile = "docker/Dockerfile"
  build_args = { ID = id, VARIANT = "blue" }
}

explicit names = exec {
  command = "printf 'tag=%s\nref=%s\n' bit-test-image-#{id}:v1 #{image.ref} > names.sh"
  outputs = "names.sh"
  inputs  = []
}
-- BUILD.bit.red --
let id = replace(sha256(project_dir()), "^(.{12}).*$", "$1")

image = docker.image {
  tag        = "bit-test-image-#{id}:v1"
  dockerfile = "docker/Dockerfile"
  build_args = { ID = id, VARIANT = "red" }
}

explicit names = exec {
  command = "printf 'tag=%s\nref=%s\n' bit-test-image-#{id}:v1 #{image.ref} > names.sh"
  outputs = "names.sh"
  inputs  = []
}
-- show.sh --
# Print a file from the image that names.sh refers to.
. ./names.sh
c=$(docker create "$ref" none) || exit 1
docker cp "$c:$1" - | tar -xO
status=$?
docker rm "$c" >/dev/null
exit $status
-- docker/Dockerfile --
FROM scratch
# A label unique to the project gives its image an ID no other run shares.
ARG ID
LABEL id=$ID
ARG VARIANT
ENV DIR=assets
COPY app.txt /app.txt
COPY ${DIR}/${VARIANT}.txt /variant.txt
-- app.txt --
app
-- assets/blue.txt --
blue
-- assets/red.txt --
unused
-- red.txt --
red
-- unrelated.txt --
unrelated
-- changed.txt --
changed
